pattern: if {f:Filter} attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger , that ability triggers an additional time

examples.text: If a Warrior attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If a Knight you control attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.

counterExamples: If a Warrior blocking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If a Warrior attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent an opponent controls to trigger, that ability triggers an additional time.
If a Warrior attacking causes a triggered ability of a permanent you control to trigger, that ability triggers two additional times.
